criterion.confirmed: azimuth registration CONFIRMED if EVERY (geometry, view) case with signal_size >= 50 has delta_r > 0 with its 95% block-bootstrap CI excluding 0, AND no evaluated case (any signal_size) has delta_r < 0 with its 95% CI excluding 0.
criterion.contradicted: CONTRADICTED if ANY evaluated case has delta_r < 0 with its 95% CI excluding 0 (the mirrored azimuth orientation fits the campaign statistically better than the true one -- a registration bug, not a symmetry artefact).
criterion.unresolved: otherwise (no case reaches signal_size, or a qualifying case's CI includes 0 -- inconclusive at this sample size, not evidence either way).

elevation_positive_control.note: Elevation is already resolved (work unit U8's Steiger test, z ~ 456 on geo-train-06); this cross-geometry re-check is a POSITIVE CONTROL for the method itself, not part of the azimuth verdict above -- if it failed to confirm here, that would indicate a bug in this check, not a real elevation registration problem.
